## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D robot story-mode game with sound but no music.
- Update it for mobile play and include a storyline and cutscenes.

## Requirements
- User explicitly requested mobile support, story content, and cutscenes.
- The initial request specified sound effects but no music.
- Build directly without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Built a browser-based Three.js game with generated geometry and synthesized sound effects.
- Planned mobile virtual joystick, touch look, fire/use buttons, and narrative cutscene overlays.

## Work State

### Completed
- Created initial game files: `package.json`, `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.
- Implemented 3D arena, movement, enemies/combat, relay objectives, HUD, synthesized SFX, and restart flow.
- Verified it renders in headless Chrome at `http://localhost:8000`; screenshot showed the scene and HUD.
- Added mobile touch-control markup and CSS styling.
- Added cutscene overlay markup and CSS styling.

- Integrate touch controls and cutscene/story sequence behavior into `game.js`.
- Ensure interaction and relay objectives work correctly on touch devices.
- Verify mobile layout and gameplay after changes.

1. Add cutscene UI references and narrative sequence logic to `game.js`; pause gameplay during cutscenes and resume on continue/skip.
2. Add pointer-based mobile joystick, touch-look, fire, and relay-use handlers; prevent unwanted touch gestures.

- `index.html`: game shell, HUD, newly added touch controls and cutscene overlay.

## Objective
- Complete a playable 3D robot story-mode game with mobile support, story content, cutscenes, and sound effects but no music.

## Requirements
- Support mobile play with touch controls.
- Include a storyline and cutscenes.
- Use sound effects, not music.
- Build directly without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Use a browser-based Three.js game with generated geometry and synthesized sound effects.
- Provide a virtual joystick, touch-look area, fire, and use buttons.
- Advance the story through cutscenes after relay activations, with a final core interaction.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented gameplay, story/cutscenes, relays/core, HUD, synthesized sound effects, restart flow, and touch controls.
- Enforced relay activation in story order; positioned Relay Three farther from the start.
- Verified the relay-to-core mission flow and victory overlay in a browser test; no page errors occurred.
- `node --check game.js` and `npm run build` passed.

### Active
- Fix mobile restart interaction: the touch `#look-pad` intercepts clicks on `#restart-btn` after victory.
- Re-test restart on mobile and inspect the latest mobile presentation.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Adjust mobile touch-control layering or pointer handling so the restart button can be clicked.
2. Re-run the mission-flow test, including restart; check the resulting mobile view.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: gameplay, story progression, relay/core interaction, input, and restart handler.
- `style.css`: responsive HUD, touch controls, and cutscene presentation; likely location for the restart hit-testing fix.
- `index.html`: HUD, touch controls, and overlays.
- `/tmp/opencode/robot_mobile_final.png`: latest opening-cutscene mobile screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked, and `dist/` is ignored.
- Browser test reached `Mission Success` with `3/3` relays and no page errors; clicking `#restart-btn` timed out because `#look-pad` intercepted pointer events.
- The latest screenshot shows the opening cutscene; it has not yet been inspected after the final relay-position adjustment.
